summary: Make Rust bounded Topo coloring safe at palette and iteration limits.
regressions: Before-fix 65-contact clique reproduces a checked shift overflow; seeded two-round clique leaves conflicting nonzero colors on unresolved contacts. Both failures were reproduced with mutable noalias disabled.

Shared regression covers empty, 1, 4, 63, 64, 65, and 129 contacts; fresh and conflicting seeded states; deterministic and nondeterministic modes; forward and reverse invocation orders; inactive stale ids, guards and idempotent finalization.
differences: A full first-free mask still returns its existing sentinel 64; the shader converts that sentinel to color zero and leaves its contact uncolored. This prevents out-of-range colors entering later neighbor scans.

A separate finalization dispatch clears colors whose final colored flag is not 1. It runs after all bounded rounds and all conflict readers, so bucket construction routes unresolved contacts to the existing unsolved bucket. No contact is silently dropped.
The Rust host bounded-coloring schedule now includes finalization. The matching TileLang changes and composed schedule will be recorded in the next change. No floating-point policy changes.
